# Bundled ViGEmBus installer

This is the unmodified `ViGEmBus_1.22.0_x64_x86_arm64.exe` from the [original Nefarius release](https://github.com/nefarius/ViGEmBus/releases/tag/v1.22.0).

SHA-256: `89220a7865076b342892f98865f3499fb7c4cfd673159e89d352c360fd014c6a`.

The installer had a valid Authenticode signature from Nefarius Software Solutions e.U. when checked on 2026-11-17. The project is BSD-3-Clause licensed; the required notice is in [LICENSE](LICENSE). PadBridge embeds the installer in its executable but never runs it without a user click and a Windows installation prompt.
